summary: Leader's Advantage Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company traded on Nasdaq under LEDRU/LEDR/LEDRW, filed an 8-K reporting consummation of its September 21, 2026 initial public offering. The company sold 15,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit for $150,000,000 gross proceeds, each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share and one-half redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50. Concurrently, it privately placed 193,125 Class A shares to underwriters at $10.00 and 1,750,000 sponsor warrants at $2.00. Total proceeds of $151,125,000, including $6,000,000 deferred underwriter discount, were deposited into an Odyssey Stock Transfer Trust Company trust account. Exhibit 99.1 contains the audited September 21, 2026 balance sheet. The 45-day over-allotment option for up to 2,250,000 additional units remains open; watch trust-size accretion and the eventual de-SPAC target announcement, with the 24-month completion clock now running as the principal risk-arb consideration.
